title: Naturality of object sections
statement: For an etale arrow b : U → V over X and a sheaf F on the small etale site of X, the object sections comparison followed by restriction along the composition comparison equals the object sections comparison at V followed by globalSectionsUpperStarMap along b.left.

proof.text: Evaluate the unit/restriction comparison for U.hom on V and the identity object of U along the lift (b.left,id), and for V.hom on V along the diagonal. Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and naturality identify their restrictions with F(b) followed by identity-object evaluation and with evaluation on V. Cancel the invertible restriction comparisons.

Apply upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app for b.left, V.hom and U.hom, evaluated on V and restricted to the identity object of U. The two ways to paste the lift agree by the three pullback projections. Naturality of the b.left unit moves restriction along the V diagonal past that unit; substitute the two restriction identities from step 1.

Expand etaleObjectSectionsIso and globalSectionsUpperStarMap. The inverse terminal-object pullback comparison followed by the map from the identity object agrees with (b.left,id) followed by pullback of the map to the terminal object, by terminal uniqueness. Generalized terminal-evaluation compatibility with restriction along any arrow follows from the terminal adjunction calculation and Sheaf.ΓRes_map; specialize at identity arrows. Unit naturality and Sheaf.ΓRes_map identify global pullback with the pointwise unit. Move upperStarComp past terminal evaluation by naturality, cancel the terminal evaluation isomorphisms and compose the equality of step 2 with inverse terminal evaluation.

lean.statement: theorem objectSections_naturality {X : Scheme.{v}} {U V : X.Etale} (b : U ⟶ V) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) : F.obj.map b.op ≫ (etaleObjectSectionsIso U).hom.app F ≫ (Sheaf.Γ U.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} b.left V.hom U.hom b.w.symm).hom.app F) = (etaleObjectSectionsIso V).hom.app F ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} b.left ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} V.hom).obj F)
